open_questions.text: Carrier credential applications are pending for all four carriers — no end-to-end test against a real carrier is possible until at least one sandbox is granted. Which carrier is expected first, and by when?
HMM onboarding appears to require a Korean business registration number and a partly Korean-language portal. Can ZHL satisfy this directly, or is a local partner / agent required?
Legal review of each carrier's API terms and conditions has not been done. Who owns it and what is the timeline before go-live?
Backend HTTP framework — the spec recommends Fastify but offers Express "to match Motus". Confirm the pick before the monorepo skeleton (chunk 1).
Job queue — `graphile-worker` (recommended) vs a hand-rolled `jobs` table with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`. Confirm before chunk 2.
Node.js and pnpm versions are not pinned.
The libsodium Node binding for `crypto_secretbox` (`sodium-native` vs `libsodium-wrappers`) is not specified.
Internal-user auth implementation (password hashing, session store, JWT library) is described only as "local users mirroring the Greenlit plan".
open_questions.resolver_owner: eng, against the referenced Greenlit auth plan (chunk 5)

open_questions.text: The `Idempotency-Key` uniqueness window has no expiry — keys are unique per `created_by` indefinitely. Is a TTL or retention window wanted?
HMM and Evergreen use proprietary (non-DCSA) booking payloads; the exact request/response shapes are unknown until their sandboxes are available.
open_questions.resolver_owner: deferred to sandbox onboarding (ties to OQ-CN-1)

open_questions.text: Who in operations owns bookings parked in `SUBMISSION_FAILED` / `CANCELLATION_FAILED`, and what is the response-time expectation?
Build-direct vs aggregator for some carriers — the spec builds direct adapters; confirm no aggregator is planned for v1.
Poll interval values (`POLL_INTERVAL_BOOKING_MIN`, `POLL_INTERVAL_TRACKING_MIN`) are not specified.
CI ephemeral-Postgres provisioning mechanism (service container, Docker, Testcontainers, etc.) is not specified.
`HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS`, `CIRCUIT_FAIL_THRESHOLD`, and the `submit_booking` retry max-attempts N are not specified.

Tracking polling has no stop condition — `CONFIRMED` bookings are polled until an operator archives them; a delivered-state stop is explicitly deferred to a later phase. Confirm this is acceptable for v1.
